notice.description: Please review how Surfare handles your information, then acknowledge the points below before using safety checks or starting the tour.

notice.policy.purpose.title: What Surfare checks
notice.policy.purpose.body: Surfare uses rules on your device to look for warning signs in messages, links, images, and QR codes, including possible scams, phishing, and misleading content. Image text recognition and QR decoding run locally. Results are guidance, not a guarantee that content is safe or a substitute for your own judgment.
notice.policy.sharing.title: What may leave your device
notice.policy.sharing.body: Online URL checks run only when your connection status is Online. A detected web address may then be sent to the lookup service on Cloudflare and Google Safe Browsing when available. The app does not upload the full message or image for this lookup. AI image check is a separate mode; when used online, it sends a smaller copy of the image for visual review. A URL can itself contain personal information. Network services also receive technical connection information, such as an IP address.
notice.policy.ai.title: AI signals and image sharing
notice.policy.ai.body: When your connection is Online, AI image check sends a smaller copy of the image for visual review. Choosing online image review lets OpenRouter and Gemini inspect that copy. Services may keep or use images in different ways, even on free plans. Do not upload an image with personal information you do not want shared. This app uses free tools only and does not switch to paid ones. AI help is a separate option. When enabled, submitted text and check details go to OpenRouter or Gemini for an extra assessment. Questions, recent chat, and check context are shared when you send a chat message. These services have their own retention and data-use policies.
notice.policy.retention.title: Storage, feedback, and improvement
notice.policy.retention.body: Submitted content, analysis results, and the local chat are held in the current page session; the app does not write them to a saved submission history. Reloading or closing the page clears this in-memory state. Your language choice and a notice version with an acknowledgment date are saved in this browser until cleared. Offline app files may also be cached. Downloaded reports remain on your device. If you send feedback, EmailJS and the configured recipient receive the fields you submit, plus the page address and send time. Provider and recipient retention follow their own policies; no fixed deletion period is promised here. Reusing submissions or feedback for model training or a learning dataset requires a separate opt-in; this version does not perform automatic learning.
notice.policy.security.title: Security and data minimization
notice.policy.security.body: Surfare reduces exposure through on-device analysis and limited online URL requests. Its lookup service includes request validation, origin restrictions, and rate limiting. These safeguards help reduce unauthorized access, disclosure, and misuse; they cannot eliminate every risk. Avoid sensitive information, passwords, private codes, and URLs containing access tokens. Share another person's data only when you have lawful authority to do so.
notice.policy.rights.title: Your rights under RA 10173
notice.policy.rights.body: Where applicable, your rights include being informed, access, correction, objection, erasure or blocking, portability, damages, and filing a complaint with the National Privacy Commission, subject to legal conditions. This notice does not waive those rights. You can turn online checks off, decline future sharing, or clear this acknowledgment below. Clearing it does not recall data already sent; requests about that data must be addressed to the responsible operator or service. See the National Privacy Commission links for rights and complaint guidance.
notice.policy.terms.title: Acceptable use and limits
notice.policy.terms.body: Use Surfare for lawful safety checks on content you are entitled to examine. Do not use it to misuse personal information, harass others, or bypass security controls. Automated results may be incomplete or wrong; a low-risk result is not proof of safety, and a warning is not proof of wrongdoing. Verify urgent requests through a trusted channel and use your own judgment. You can decline this notice and browse the information pages; safety checks and the tour will ask you to acknowledge it first.
signal.violence: The message contains texts that show violence.
signal.extortion: The message tries to pressure you by demanding money or something else.
signal.blackmail: The message threatens to expose private information.
signal.intimidation: The message tries to scare or intimidate you.
signal.harassment: The message keeps targeting or bothering you.
signal.secret: The message asks you to keep something secret.
signal.advance-fee: The message asks for money first before giving something in return.
signal.investment: The message pushes an investment that may not be real.
signal.job-fee: The message asks you to pay to get a job or task.
signal.remote: The message asks for access to your device or account.
signal.personal: The message asks for private information.
signal.scam: The message looks like a trick to get money or information.
signal.other: Something in the message does not look right.
signalHelp.pressure: Pressure can make you decide before you have time to check. Pause and verify the request separately.
signalHelp.codes: Someone who gets your code may be able to sign in or approve a payment. Do not share it.
signalHelp.account: Sharing account details or access can let someone take over your account. Use the official app to check.
signalHelp.money: You could lose money if you pay before checking the offer. Verify who is asking and what you are paying for.
signalHelp.identity: A familiar name is easy to copy. Confirm the sender or full web address through the official app or website.
signalHelp.secrecy: Keeping it secret can stop someone you trust from spotting a problem. Ask them before acting.
signalHelp.address: This can hide where the link really goes. Check the full address before opening it or entering details.
signalHelp.weakAddress: This clue alone does not prove a scam. It only matters alongside the request and other warning signs.
signalHelp.pattern: Similar wording or addresses appeared in the reference data. Similarity can be wrong, so it is a clue rather than proof.
signalHelp.report: This finding is based on a regulator list or notice. Check the official notice and the exact service or web address.
ask.signalNotFound: That warning is not among the tags in this result. I can explain the highlighted phrases, but I should not say a warning was found when it was not.
ask.uncertain.answer: These checks can miss scams or flag a real message by mistake. The tags show clues, not proof. Confirm unexpected requests through an official app or a number you already trust.
signal.loan-fee: The offer asks for payment before releasing a loan.
signal.task-recruitment: The message offers easy earnings and asks you to contact a recruiter.
signal.cancel-lure: The message asks you to use a link to cancel an unexpected charge.
signal.benefit-claim: The message asks you to claim a benefit through a contact or link.
signal.load-transfer: The message asks you to dial a code that may transfer your load.
signal.guaranteed-winnings: The sender promises to make you win money.
signal.winnings-deposit: The sender asks for a cash-in or deposit in exchange for promised winnings.
ask.aiConsent: Let AI double-check results and answer your questions. Shares your message, check details, and chat with OpenRouter or Gemini.
ask.aiMode: AI help is on. Ask follow-up or general questions.
ask.localMode: Local explanations. Turn on AI help above for more questions.
ask.aiUnavailable: Online AI is unavailable right now. Here is what I can explain locally:
ask.review.completed: AI double-check completed. AI can still make mistakes.
ask.review.unavailable: AI double-check could not finish. This result uses local checks and any completed link checks.
ask.review.pending: Local check ready. AI is taking a second look.
